name: limit-field
title: Limit field
description: A number that can also be no limit: a switch for Unlimited that reveals the number field, for usage limits, seats and quotas.
docs: value and onValueChange speak a number, or null for no limit; defaultValue null starts unlimited. Turning the switch on brings back the last number (defaultLimit, 100, the first time) and moves the focus into the number field; turning it off reports null and keeps the number for next time. min defaults to 1, because a limit of 0 would be no use, and max bounds the number. unit is a word shown behind the number, or { one, other } to follow the number (1 seat, 10 seats) with locale choosing the plural. offLabel is what the field says while it is unlimited. The switch controls the number, and the number is named after the switch and read with its unit (Usage limit, 100 uses). name posts the number, or an empty value while it is unlimited. id, aria-invalid, aria-describedby, aria-label and aria-labelledby go to the number, so a form label and an error line can be wired to it; aria-invalid gives it the error border.
